10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:7bfed69b-ad3c-45.title: Product Designer - AI Trainer - Freelance - 8-20hrs/week - Remote
10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:7bfed69b-ad3c-45.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced product designer who instinctively spots gaps in design reasoning and understands the complex realities of product design practice? Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main job or consulting projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies product design expertise at scale. About the Role 10x.team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are looking for knowledgeable product designers based in the EU or UK to enhance the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered design systems. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to product design, design processes, documentation, and practical aspects of product development - Evaluate AI responses for creative quality, practical application, and compliance with real-world requirements - Draft realistic product design scenarios based on your direct professional experience - Create scenario variations from different perspectives (e.g. product designer, client, user, or stakeholder) - Identify gaps, oversights, or weak reasoning in AI-generated design content In simple terms: You will assess and improve AI-generated content, ensuring it reflects true product design reasoning, authentic documentation, and practical procedures. Rather than conducting traditional design projects, you’ll apply your expertise to help AI systems understand and reason about product design at scale. Who You Are - A senior-level product designer with significant professional experience within the EU or UK - Experienced in advising on, preparing, and executing product design projects - Skilled at evaluating design solutions, documentation, and compliance with requirements - Comfortable working independently and providing structured, critical feedback - Available for 8–20 hours per week, with prompt availability Why Join? - Flexible, fully remote freelance work that fits your current commitments - Apply your product design expertise in a rapidly evolving, high-impact AI environment - Directly contribute to building advanced AI-powered design systems - Free access to our in-house AI Academy to further develop your AI skillset - Clear onboarding, structured tasks, and ongoing opportunities for collaboration How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Join us to help shape the product design expertise of the world’s most advanced AI models! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:bb2dc07f-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Our Senior Software Engineers lead and mentor engineers, delivering high-value products for our customers and infrastructure that enables our business to scale. Vanta’s team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it’s essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to enable us to scale with our business. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for setting technical direction to enable our product and infrastructure to scale with our business, driving complex projects across our technical stack, and mentoring our talented engineering team. Your past experience will be leveraged to enable and accelerate Vanta’s growth. Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We’re growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company. As part of an ambitious regional expansion strategy, Routres is building a commercial team to strengthen its presence across Spanish-speaking South American markets. The role oversees the complete B2B sales process, including prospecting, opportunity management, negotiations, contract execution, customer retention, and post-sale support. This position works closely with international stakeholders across Europe, Asia, and Latin America to support Routres' expansion strategy. Compensation & Benefits Compensation Base Salary: USD $1,600 per month Competitive Commission Structure Performance-Based Bonuses Additional Sales Incentives Benefits Health & Wellness Allowance Gym / Sports Allowance International Travel Opportunities Performance-Based Reward Trips Global Career Exposure Potential Phone or Tablet Allowance Depending on Country Key Responsibilities Commercial Strategy Develop and execute regional sales strategies. Regional Leadership Support recruitment and onboarding of Sales Representatives. Assist with territory development and commercial planning. Monitor sales performance and team effectiveness. Customer & Supplier Management Collaborate with customers throughout Latin America. Coordinate with international suppliers from Europe and Asia. Manage key strategic accounts. Reporting Track KPIs, revenue, margins, and commercial performance. Present business updates and forecasts to executive leadership. Maintain CRM and pipeline accuracy. Required Qualifications Must-Haves 5+ years of B2B sales experience. Minimum 3 years of direct steel industry experience. Ability to travel frequently. Strong communication and business development skills. Preferred Sales leadership experience. International trade experience. Supply chain or logistics knowledge. Experience working with suppliers in Europe and Asia. Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related fields. Non-Negotiables ✅ Steel industry experience ✅ Strong B2B sales experience ✅ Advanced English proficiency (C1+) ✅ Willingness to travel internationally ✅ CRM experience ✅ Stable employment history ✅ Experience managing commercial negotiations What Success Looks Like Within the first year, the Sales Manager will: Establish Routres as a strategic steel marketplace across Spanish South America. jobgether-jobgether:lever:097367d8-e993-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Legal & Compliance based in France. This is a senior, hands-on legal and compliance leadership role within a fast-growing AI-powered B2B technology environment. You will own the legal framework surrounding data, AI-powered calling, privacy, telemarketing compliance, and enterprise customer requirements. The role is designed to be built from the ground up, giving you significant ownership over processes, policies, and risk frameworks. You will work directly with Product and Engineering, helping shape features and technical decisions rather than reviewing them only after development. You will also lead commercial negotiations and enterprise legal and security reviews, helping remove friction from strategic deals. The position requires strong judgment, commercial awareness, and the ability to translate complex regulations into practical product requirements. It is an opportunity to establish a scalable legal and compliance function while becoming a trusted advisor across the business. Own the legal and compliance framework for AI-powered calling and dialer functionality, including TCPA requirements, consent, do-not-call obligations, call recording, and disclosures relating to AI-generated voice. Partner closely with Product and Engineering to ensure compliance requirements are implemented directly within platform workflows, controls, and technical processes. Manage external specialist legal advisors, including a TCPA-focused firm, and determine which matters should be escalated externally versus handled internally. Lead the privacy program across applicable regulations, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and emerging US state privacy requirements. Manage data-subject requests, opt-outs, data broker registration requirements, and other operational privacy processes. Own data sourcing and governance practices, including supplier diligence, lawful-basis assessments, legitimate interest assessments, DPIAs, and transfer impact assessments. Serve as the designated DPO and establish an effective approach to AI governance as new AI and agentic capabilities are introduced. Draft, review, and negotiate customer and vendor agreements, data processing agreements, and other commercial legal documentation. Lead enterprise security and privacy reviews, working to remove legal and compliance barriers that could delay or prevent strategic customer opportunities. Serve as a key legal contact for enterprise customers and their counsel, building confidence and helping facilitate successful commercial relationships. Participate directly in product and roadmap planning, identifying regulatory considerations early enough to influence product design and development. Translate regulatory requirements into clear, practical product and engineering requirements that teams can implement effectively. Assess emerging regulatory developments, distinguish material risks from overly cautious interpretations, and help the business move quickly while maintaining appropriate compliance standards. Build and scale legal and compliance processes from the ground up, establishing only the frameworks, controls, and documentation that create meaningful business value. Requirements 8+ years of combined law firm and in-house legal experience, with qualification to practice law in the United States. Deep, practical privacy experience, particularly with GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, including applying these frameworks to real products, data flows, and business operations. Strong experience advising Product and Engineering teams and participating directly in technical and product decision-making. Proven ability to establish or significantly develop a legal and compliance function in an early-stage or high-growth environment. Strong understanding of data privacy, data sourcing, AI governance, and regulatory risk management. Experience with TCPA, telephony, dial

jobgether-jobgether:lever:15168925-8493-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in France. This role offers the opportunity to shape how sensitive data is stored, accessed, and protected across a complex enterprise environment. You will assess data sensitivity, system usage, workflows, and storage practices across multiple business areas. A key focus will be identifying high-risk use cases and determining where VDI, stronger access controls, or other secure solutions can provide the best protection. You will translate detailed analysis into practical recommendations, business cases, and migration roadmaps. Working closely with Security, Technology, and business stakeholders, you will help align solutions with data protection and governance requirements. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in Austria. This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments. All activities are conducted in controlled environments for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional-development purposes. Triage and evaluate threat information: Review multiple sources of simulated threat intelligence, determine relevance, assess reliability and credibility, and identify information requiring further investigation. Analyze threats and adversary behavior: Assess simulated threat actors, including their motivations, capabilities, targeting patterns, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and determine their potential relevance to an organization. Assess indicators in context: Evaluate indicators of compromise alongside supporting evidence rather than treating individual indicators as definitive proof of malicious activity. Identify intelligence gaps: Determine what critical information is missing and define the additional intelligence required to improve security decision-making. Develop intelligence requirements: Create or refine priority intelligence questions based on organizational assets, threat exposure, business priorities, and stakeholder needs. Prioritize threats: Compare competing threats according to relevance, likelihood, potential impact, available evidence, and organizational priorities. Apply structured analytical reasoning: Evaluate competing hypotheses, weigh evidence, document assumptions, and communicate why one assessment may be better supported than another. Communicate analytical confidence: Clearly articulate confidence levels, evidence quality, assumptions, and factors that limit certainty. Brief decision-makers: Translate technical threat intelligence into concise, business-relevant insights and recommendations for senior or non-technical stakeholders. Update assessments: Reassess previous conclusions when new intelligence becomes available and clearly explain how additional evidence changes—or does not change—the original assessment.
